scope: adds the X1 exploratory addendum and the R2-0B preparation; the contract metrics, comparisons, primary metric, readings and promotion rules are unchanged

x1.weights: the group game-macro weights of the contract: w_i / (W_g * G)
x1.decomposition: L = sum_s Omega_s (mu_s^2 + sigma_s^2) by side to move (exact, descriptive)
x1.bootstrap: the contract bootstrap (samples, seed, percentile 0.95); cross-fitted offsets re-estimated in every replicate
x1.reading: post-hoc exploratory: no promotion, confirmation or independent evidence; no change of the primary metric or of the R2-0A readings

r2_0b.recipe: c8 (unmasked): parent c5, the c8 cycle cache and rows, the frozen H6 v3 replay cache, the c8 config with only the training seed replaced; T-val checkpoint selection; H-dev unused

reproduction.note: operational tolerances fixed before any R2-0B run, not statistically derived; never relaxed after results
